It is also used from outside that block: PlantUML line 38: `lane_change_urban --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<0.7`; PlantUML line 46: `UrbanMode --> FinishState : auto_finished=true`. The exact closed model reaches the designated FinishState through the protected completion route, but the target belongs to the HighwayMode ancestry and retains outgoing completion and mode-routing behavior, so the active UrbanMode completion is not stable.
issues.expected: UrbanMode reaches FinishState as a stable completion state without continued behavior through the target or its active ancestors.
issues.observed: The completion route enters state:FinishState:line:22 under HighwayMode, while FinishState and its HighwayMode ancestor retain outgoing auto_finished and mode-routing continuation paths; the designated target is not a stable terminal boundary for UrbanMode.
issues.reason: The termination property is stronger than endpoint existence. Exact target ancestry and outgoing target/ancestor continuations show that the UrbanMode completion route can continue operating rather than remain completed.
issues.requirement_quote: The system exits the UrbanMode state by transitioning to FinishState
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The authored source names FinishState as the UrbanMode exit target and the protected macro supplies the target-entry path; this rebuts a missing-edge claim but does not rebut the observed continuation of the exact target and active ancestor.
issues.title: UrbanMode completion is not stable

issues.basis: NL12 identifies CollisionAvoidanceSystem as a required operating subsystem. Exact finite reachability facts refute root reachability for the composite and both owned states, while the local initial edge only establishes nested topology and cannot provide root reachability.
issues.expected: CollisionAvoidanceSystem is reachable from a top-level initial entry.
issues.observed: The exact composite state:CollisionAvoidanceSystem:line:73 is not reachable from a top-level initial entry; its local initial transition:line:76 and both child states remain outside the root-reachable set.
issues.reason: This is an exact root-reachability failure for the required composite. The nested initial edge is present, but it cannot satisfy the distinct global reachability requirement.
issues.requirement_quote: The collision avoidance system is initially in the collision_avoidance_deactive state. It transitions to collision_avoidance_active when certain conditions are met
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The subsystem has an exact local initial edge to collision_avoidance_deactive, but deterministic root reachability remains refuted and a local entry does not make the composite reachable from the model root.
issues.title: Collision avoidance subsystem is unreachable

issues.basis: NL12 and NL13 require the collision avoidance responses to operate within CollisionAvoidanceSystem. Exact event-consumer facts show declared consumers transition:line:77 and transition:line:78, but both have empty reachable consumer sets; the subsystem and its states are also refuted as root reachable.
issues.expected: The collision avoidance scope contains reachable consumers for the danger-to-active and inactive-danger-to-deactive responses.
issues.observed: The danger event has declared consumer transition:line:77 but reachable_consumer_transition_refs is empty, and the clear-condition event has declared consumer transition:line:78 but reachable_consumer_transition_refs is empty. Both consumers are in an unreachable subsystem.
issues.reason: Declaration-only presence does not discharge operational coverage. The exact consumer set is known and complete, and deterministic facts refute reachability for both required response consumers.
issues.requirement_quote: It transitions to collision_avoidance_active when certain conditions are met... Once in the collision_avoidance_active state, the collision avoidance system returns to the collision_avoidance_deactive state
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Both response transitions are declared and their endpoint identities match the source, but the supplied finite consumer facts specifically distinguish declared consumers from reachable consumers and show no reachable consumer for either event.
issues.title: Collision responses have no reachable consumers
